# quotation-contractor.pages.dev — Quotation & Invoice System

This is a static web application for contractors to create, manage, and export quotation/invoice/receipt/delivery-letter documents.

## Pages

- / — Home / Dashboard (4 document cards + company profile)
- /quotation — Quotation / Proposal (PCC-2569-001 numbering)
- /invoice — Tax Invoice (INV-2569-001 numbering)
- /receipt — Receipt / Tax Receipt (RC-2569-001 numbering)
- /delivery-letter — Delivery Letter (work handover)
- /login — Authentication (JWT, 30-day session)

## Data Storage

- Backend: Cloudflare Pages Functions + D1 SQLite
- Documents stored per company (multi-tenant)
- Document number format: [TYPE]-BE-Year-### (e.g., INV-2569-001)
- Auth: Email + Password (JWT stored in localStorage as quota_api_token)

## Features

- Document CRUD via D1 API
- Numbering counter with duplicate warning
- Export to JSON / ZIP / PDF
- Import from JSON
- Archive / File System Access
- Profile management (company name, tax ID, bank info)

## Key Files

- /assets/api.js — D1 CRUD client
- /assets/docs-api.js — Async document panel
- /assets/docnum.js — Document numbering (BE year only)
- /assets/gate.js — Authentication gate (client-side)
- /assets/profile.js — Company profile manager
- /schema.sql — D1 database schema
